relationships.subject: Daphnetin
relationships.evidence_quote: After 3 days of intrathecal injection of DAP, the expression of inflammatory factors in the spinal cords of CCI rats was significantly inhibited

relationships.subject: Daphnetin
relationships.evidence_quote: After intrathecal injection of DAP, we observed significant inhibition of the upregulation of P2X4 protein in the western blot and immunofluorescence results

relationships.subject: Daphnetin
relationships.evidence_quote: After intrathecal injection of DAP, the level of BDNF protein decreased significantly compared with that in the model group (p < 0.01).

relationships.subject: Daphnetin
relationships.evidence_quote: In summary, DAP reduces the expression of inflammatory factors in the spinal cord by inhibiting the P38 MAPK pathway in microglia.

relationships.subject: IRF5
relationships.evidence_quote: IRF5 induces the expression of the P2X4 receptors by directly binding to the promoter region of the P2X4 gene

key_findings: Intrathecal daphnetin raised withdrawal thresholds in CCI rats and suppressed spinal microglial activation, TNF-alpha, IL-1beta and IL-6.
Daphnetin reduced the IRF8/IRF5/P2X4/BDNF axis and p-p38, and altered glycerophospholipid metabolism in the spinal cord.
